headline: Drake Performs 'Over' With Gordo in Toronto: Akademiks Drops Video
body: DJ Akademiks has shared a video showing Drake performing 'Over' with Gordo at a Toronto show. The post, published September 6, 2026, shows the artist in a chill Toronto setting with the iconic 'Over' track. The post has garnered 6,133 likes and 365 comments. The video features Drake and Gordo in a relaxed, festive atmosphere with the 🧊🦉 emojis hinting at the track's theme.
